title: col-taxdata CASE application contracts v5
description: Evidence-first CASE v4 contracts separating intake-only model output, platform-owned research/evidence/rules/evaluations, unresolved state, and a transport-safe LegalResearchBundle.

x-semantic-invariants.V5-REF-ASPECT-001: Every ResearchTask.aspect_ref resolves to exactly one ResearchAspect in the owning plan and task/question ownership agrees.
x-semantic-invariants.V5-REF-SELECTION-002: EvidenceSelection aspect/task/authority/evidence refs resolve to the declared typed registries.
x-semantic-invariants.V5-REF-COVERAGE-003: AspectCoverage task/selection/omission/unresolved refs resolve within the owning result/bundle.
x-semantic-invariants.V5-COMPLETE-001: A complete ResearchResult/LegalResearchBundle requires minimum complete support closure for every required finite-scope aspect.
x-semantic-invariants.V5-OMISSION-001: Required research/support omission prevents complete support closure and complete result status.
x-semantic-invariants.V5-CONTEXT-001: Context-incomplete selected evidence cannot close required aspect support.
x-semantic-invariants.V5-TEMPORAL-001: Caller as_of_date ownership is preserved; absent date remains absent and temporal applicability is explicitly unassessed.
x-semantic-invariants.V5-FACT-001: Missing/ambiguous facts block only linked aspect work; unrelated general research may continue.
x-semantic-invariants.V5-EVALUATOR-001: A deterministic evaluator is not required for evidence support closure; interpretive synthesis may remain an external handoff.
x-semantic-invariants.V5-SCOPE-001: generic_limited or unknown_unplanned scope cannot produce complete result/bundle status.
x-semantic-invariants.V5-CONSUMER-001: Consumer continuation requests are non-canonical input and cannot be promoted directly into canonical evidence or legal conclusions.
x-semantic-invariants.V5-ID-001: New derived refs are versioned/stable only under their documented identity material; persistence backend changes alone do not redefine domain identity.
